name: Acid Splash
summary: A bubble of acid bursts in a 5-foot sphere. Creatures inside make a Dex save or take 1d6 acid damage. Damage grows at levels 5, 11 and 17.

name: Blade Ward
summary: While it lasts, any creature attacking you subtracts 1d4 from its attack roll.

name: Chill Touch
summary: Melee spell attack for 1d10 necrotic damage; the target can't regain hit points until the end of your next turn.

name: Dancing Lights
summary: Up to four floating torch-like lights (or one glowing humanoid shape) that you can move with a bonus action.

name: Elementalism
summary: Small elemental tricks: stir a breeze, raise dust, kindle or snuff a small flame, make a puff of mist, or shape a cube of earth, fire, water or air into a crude form.

name: Fire Bolt
summary: Ranged spell attack for 1d10 fire damage. Unattended flammable objects it hits catch fire.

name: Friends
summary: One humanoid makes a Wis save or is charmed by you. It ends early if you harm or threaten anyone, and the target knows afterward.

name: Light
summary: An object you touch sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light 20 feet beyond.

name: Mage Hand
summary: A spectral hand that can manipulate objects, open containers and carry up to 10 pounds. It can't attack.

name: Mending
summary: Repairs a single break or tear in an object, such as a broken chain link or a torn cloak.

name: Message
summary: Whisper a message to a creature in range; only it hears, and it can whisper a reply. Passes around corners and through small gaps.

name: Mind Sliver
summary: Int save or 1d6 psychic damage, and the target subtracts 1d4 from its next saving throw.

name: Minor Illusion
summary: Create a sound or a still image of an object no larger than a 5-foot cube. A successful Investigation check reveals it.

name: Poison Spray
summary: Ranged spell attack that deals 1d12 poison damage.

name: Prestidigitation
summary: Minor magic: sensory effects, light or snuff a candle, clean or soil, chill or warm, flavour food, make a small mark or trinket.

name: Ray of Frost
summary: Ranged spell attack for 1d8 cold damage, and the target's speed drops by 10 feet until your next turn.

name: Shocking Grasp
summary: Melee spell attack for 1d8 lightning damage; the target can't make opportunity attacks until its next turn.

name: Thunderclap
summary: Each creature within 5 feet of you makes a Con save or takes 1d6 thunder damage. Audible 100 feet away.

name: Toll the Dead
summary: Wis save or 1d8 necrotic damage, or 1d12 if the target is already missing hit points.

name: True Strike
summary: Make one attack with the weapon used as a focus, using your spellcasting ability; you can make its damage radiant. Extra radiant damage at higher levels.

name: Alarm
summary: Ward a door, window or area up to a 20-foot cube. When a creature enters, you get a mental ping or an audible bell.

name: Burning Hands
summary: Flames fan from your hands. Dex save or 3d6 fire damage, half on success.

name: Charm Person
summary: A humanoid makes a Wis save (with advantage if you are fighting it) or is charmed by you.

name: Chromatic Orb
summary: Ranged spell attack for 3d8 damage of a type you choose (acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison or thunder). On matching damage dice the orb can leap to another target.

name: Color Spray
summary: Dazzling light. Each creature in the cone makes a Con save or is blinded until the end of your next turn.

name: Comprehend Languages
summary: You understand any spoken or written language you hear or touch.

name: Detect Magic
summary: Sense magic within 30 feet and see the aura and school of magic on visible creatures and objects.

name: Disguise Self
summary: Change how you look, including clothes and gear. Physical inspection can reveal the illusion.

name: Expeditious Retreat
summary: Take the Dash action now, and as a bonus action on each later turn.

name: False Life
summary: Gain 2d4 + 4 temporary hit points.

name: Feather Fall
summary: Up to five falling creatures drift down slowly and take no falling damage.

name: Find Familiar
summary: Summon a spirit familiar in a small animal form. You share its senses telepathically and it can deliver your touch spells.

name: Fog Cloud
summary: A 20-foot-radius sphere of fog that heavily obscures the area. A strong wind disperses it.

name: Grease
summary: A 10-foot square of slick grease. Creatures in it make a Dex save or fall prone.

name: Ice Knife
summary: Ranged attack for 1d10 piercing; the shard then explodes, and everyone within 5 feet of the target makes a Dex save or takes 2d6 cold.

name: Identify
summary: Learn a magic item's properties, how to use it, its charges and any spells affecting it.

name: Illusory Script
summary: Write a message only chosen creatures can read; to everyone else it looks like gibberish or a different message.

name: Jump
summary: Once per turn the target can leap up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.

name: Longstrider
summary: The target's speed increases by 10 feet.

name: Mage Armor
summary: A willing creature not wearing armor gets a base AC of 13 + its Dex modifier.

name: Magic Missile
summary: Three glowing darts that never miss, each dealing 1d4 + 1 force damage. One extra dart per slot level above 1st.

name: Protection from Evil and Good
summary: Wards against aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends and undead: they attack with disadvantage and can't charm, frighten or possess the target.

name: Ray of Sickness
summary: Ranged spell attack for 2d8 poison damage; the target is poisoned until the end of your next turn.

name: Shield
summary: +5 AC until your next turn, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from Magic Missile.

name: Silent Image
summary: A soundless visual illusion up to a 15-foot cube that you can move.

name: Sleep
summary: Creatures in a 5-foot sphere make a Wis save or are incapacitated; a failed second save leaves them unconscious until harmed or shaken awake.

name: Tasha's Hideous Laughter
summary: Wis save or the target falls prone, incapacitated by laughter. It repeats the save at the end of its turns and when it takes damage.

name: Tenser's Floating Disk
summary: A 3-foot disk of force that follows you at waist height and carries up to 500 pounds.

name: Thunderwave
summary: Con save or 2d8 thunder damage and pushed 10 feet away; half on success. Audible 300 feet away.

name: Unseen Servant
summary: An invisible, mindless force that performs simple tasks such as fetching, cleaning and serving.

name: Witch Bolt
summary: Ranged spell attack for 2d12 lightning. On later turns, a bonus action deals 1d12 lightning to the same target automatically.

name: Alter Self
summary: Reshape yourself: adapt to water, change your appearance, or grow natural weapons.

name: Arcane Lock
summary: Magically lock a door, window, gate or chest. You and creatures you choose can open it; others need Knock or a much harder check.

name: Arcane Vigor
summary: Spend and roll two of your Hit Point Dice; regain hit points equal to the total plus your spellcasting modifier.

name: Augury
summary: Ask about a course of action in the next 30 minutes and receive an omen: weal, woe, both, or neither.

name: Blindness/Deafness
summary: Con save or the target is blinded or deafened (your choice). It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

name: Blur
summary: Your shape shifts and wavers; attacks against you have disadvantage.

name: Cloud of Daggers
summary: A 5-foot cube of spinning daggers that deals 4d4 slashing to creatures that enter it or end their turn there. You can move it.

name: Continual Flame
summary: A heatless flame as bright as a torch that never goes out.

name: Crown of Madness
summary: Wis save or the humanoid is charmed and must attack a creature you choose. You must spend your action each turn to keep control.

name: Darkness
summary: Magical darkness fills a 15-foot sphere. Darkvision can't see through it and nonmagical light can't brighten it.

name: Darkvision
summary: The target gains darkvision out to 150 feet.

name: Detect Thoughts
summary: Sense thoughts nearby and read surface thoughts. You can probe deeper, but the target may resist with a Wis save.

name: Enhance Ability
summary: The target has advantage on checks using one ability of your choice.

name: Enlarge/Reduce
summary: Grow a creature or object one size larger (extra 1d4 weapon damage) or shrink it one size smaller (less damage). Unwilling targets save with Con.

name: Flaming Sphere
summary: A 5-foot ball of fire you roll around with a bonus action, dealing 2d6 fire to nearby creatures (Dex save for half).

name: Gentle Repose
summary: A corpse doesn't decay and can't become undead, and the time limit on raising it is extended.

name: Gust of Wind
summary: A strong wind blows from you. Creatures make a Str save or are pushed back 15 feet; flames go out.

name: Hold Person
summary: Wis save or the humanoid is paralyzed. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

name: Invisibility
summary: A creature turns invisible, along with what it wears and carries. Ends if it attacks, deals damage or casts a spell.

name: Knock
summary: Unlocks a door, chest or similar object, or suppresses Arcane Lock for 10 minutes. Makes a loud knock audible 300 feet away.

name: Levitate
summary: Raise a creature or object up to 20 feet off the ground. Unwilling targets make a Con save.

name: Locate Object
summary: Sense the direction of an object you know within 1,000 feet. Lead blocks it.

name: Magic Mouth
summary: Implant a spoken message in an object that plays when a condition you set is met.

name: Magic Weapon
summary: A nonmagical weapon becomes magical with +1 to attack and damage rolls (more with higher slots).

name: Melf's Acid Arrow
summary: Ranged spell attack for 4d4 acid now and 2d4 acid at the end of the target's next turn. Half the initial damage on a miss.

name: Mind Spike
summary: Wis save or 3d8 psychic damage (half on success). On a failure you always know the target's location and it can't hide from you.

name: Mirror Image
summary: Three illusory duplicates appear. Each attack against you may hit a duplicate instead, destroying it.

name: Misty Step
summary: Teleport up to 30 feet to a spot you can see.

name: Nystul's Magic Aura
summary: Mask or change how a creature or object appears to divination spells: hide magic, fake magic, or change its creature type.

name: Phantasmal Force
summary: Int save or the target perceives a phantasm only it can see, and takes 2d8 psychic damage each round it is affected by it.

name: Ray of Enfeeblement
summary: Con save or the target is weakened: disadvantage on Strength tests and its Strength attacks deal less damage.

name: Rope Trick
summary: A rope opens an invisible extradimensional space at its top where up to eight Medium creatures can hide.

name: Scorching Ray
summary: Three rays of fire, each a ranged spell attack for 2d6 fire damage. One more ray per higher slot.

name: See Invisibility
summary: You see invisible creatures and objects, and into the Ethereal Plane.

name: Shatter
summary: A ringing burst in a 10-foot sphere: Con save or 3d8 thunder damage, half on success. Constructs and stone creatures save with disadvantage.

name: Spider Climb
summary: The target can climb walls and ceilings hands-free and gains a climb speed equal to its speed.

name: Suggestion
summary: Wis save or the target pursues a reasonable-sounding course of action you describe in 25 words or fewer.

name: Web
summary: A 20-foot cube of sticky webbing. Creatures entering make a Dex save or are restrained. Webs are flammable.

name: Animate Dead
summary: Raise a skeleton or zombie from bones or a corpse. It obeys you for 24 hours; recast to keep control.

name: Bestow Curse
summary: Wis save or the target is cursed: disadvantage on one ability, lost turns, extra necrotic damage from you, or another curse you devise.

name: Blink
summary: At the end of each of your turns, roll: on 11+ you vanish into the Ethereal Plane until your next turn.

name: Clairvoyance
summary: Create an invisible sensor at a place you know and see or hear through it.

name: Counterspell
summary: Interrupt a creature casting a spell. It makes a Con save; on a failure the spell fails and the slot isn't spent.

name: Dispel Magic
summary: End spells of 3rd level or lower on a creature, object or effect; higher-level spells need an ability check.

name: Fear
summary: Wis save or creatures drop what they hold, become frightened, and must Dash away from you.

name: Feign Death
summary: A willing creature appears dead to all inspection. It is blinded and incapacitated but resists all damage except psychic.

name: Fireball
summary: A bead of flame bursts in a 20-foot sphere. Dex save or 8d6 fire damage, half on success.

name: Fly
summary: The target gains a fly speed of 60 feet. Extra targets with higher slots.

name: Gaseous Form
summary: A willing creature becomes a slow-flying misty cloud that resists damage and slips through cracks.

name: Glyph of Warding
summary: Inscribe a near-invisible glyph that triggers an explosion or stores a spell when its condition is met.

name: Haste
summary: Doubled speed, +2 AC, advantage on Dex saves and an extra limited action each turn. When it ends, the target loses a turn.

name: Hypnotic Pattern
summary: A twisting pattern of colour in a 30-foot cube. Wis save or creatures are charmed and incapacitated until shaken or harmed.

name: Leomund's Tiny Hut
summary: A 10-foot dome of force forms around you. Creatures and objects outside can't pass in, and the weather can't reach inside.

name: Lightning Bolt
summary: A 100-foot line of lightning. Dex save or 8d6 lightning damage, half on success.

name: Magic Circle
summary: A cylinder that hinders chosen creature types from entering or harming those inside, or can be reversed to trap one.

name: Major Image
summary: An illusion up to a 20-foot cube with sound, smell and temperature. Cast at 4th+ it can be permanent.

name: Nondetection
summary: Hides a creature, place or object from divination magic and scrying sensors.

name: Phantom Steed
summary: Summon a quasi-real horse with a 100-foot speed.

name: Protection from Energy
summary: The target has resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder damage (your choice).

name: Remove Curse
summary: Ends all curses on a creature or object. A cursed magic item's curse stays but the owner can unattune.

name: Sending
summary: Send a short message of 25 words to a creature you know, anywhere; it can reply in kind.

name: Sleet Storm
summary: Freezing sleet fills a 40-foot cylinder: heavily obscured, difficult terrain, and creatures may fall prone and lose concentration.

name: Slow
summary: Up to six creatures make a Wis save or are slowed: half speed, -2 AC and Dex saves, limited actions, no reactions.

name: Speak with Dead
summary: A corpse answers up to five questions with what it knew in life.

name: Stinking Cloud
summary: A 20-foot sphere of nauseating gas. Creatures that start there make a Con save or are poisoned and lose their action.

name: Summon Fey
summary: Call a Fey Spirit (fuming, mirthful or tricksy) that fights alongside you and can teleport.

name: Summon Undead
summary: Call an Undead Spirit (ghostly, putrid or skeletal) that obeys your commands.

name: Tongues
summary: The target understands any spoken language and is understood by any creature that knows a language.

name: Vampiric Touch
summary: Melee spell attack for 3d6 necrotic; you regain half the damage. Repeat the attack each turn as an action.

name: Water Breathing
summary: Up to ten willing creatures can breathe underwater.

name: Arcane Eye
summary: An invisible floating eye you can see through and move up to 30 feet each turn.

name: Banishment
summary: Cha save or the target is sent to a harmless demiplane. Extraplanar creatures that stay gone a full minute don't return.

name: Blight
summary: Drain moisture and life: Con save or 8d8 necrotic damage, half on success. Plants suffer the worst of it.

name: Charm Monster
summary: Like Charm Person but works on any creature. Wis save, with advantage if you are fighting it.

name: Confusion
summary: Creatures in a 10-foot sphere make a Wis save or act randomly each turn.

name: Conjure Minor Elementals
summary: Elemental spirits swirl around you. Your attacks deal extra elemental damage, and the area around you is difficult terrain for enemies.

name: Control Water
summary: Shape water in a 100-foot cube: flood, part, redirect a flow or make a whirlpool.

name: Dimension Door
summary: Teleport yourself and one willing creature up to 500 feet to a spot you can see or describe.

name: Divination
summary: Ask a god's servants one question about something within the next 7 days and receive a truthful, possibly cryptic reply.

name: Evard's Black Tentacles
summary: Tentacles fill a 20-foot square. Creatures make a Str save or are restrained and take bludgeoning damage.

name: Fabricate
summary: Turn raw materials into finished products, such as a bridge from timber or clothes from flax.

name: Fire Shield
summary: Warm or chill flames wreathe you, granting resistance to cold or fire and burning creatures that hit you in melee.

name: Greater Invisibility
summary: The target is invisible even while it attacks or casts spells.

name: Hallucinatory Terrain
summary: Make natural terrain in a 150-foot cube look, sound and smell like a different kind of terrain.

name: Ice Storm
summary: Hail pounds a 20-foot cylinder for bludgeoning and cold damage (Dex save for half); the ground becomes difficult terrain.

name: Leomund's Secret Chest
summary: Hide a chest in the Ethereal Plane and recall it at will using a tiny replica.

name: Locate Creature
summary: Sense the direction of a creature you know within 1,000 feet. Running water blocks it.

name: Mordenkainen's Faithful Hound
summary: An invisible watchdog that barks at intruders and bites hostile creatures near it.

name: Mordenkainen's Private Sanctum
summary: Secure an area against sound, vision, divination, teleportation and planar travel, in any combination.

name: Otiluke's Resilient Sphere
summary: A sphere of force encloses a creature or object. Nothing passes through it, though the occupant can roll it.

name: Phantasmal Killer
summary: Wis save or the target sees its worst fear: psychic damage each turn and disadvantage on checks and attacks.

name: Polymorph
summary: Transform a creature into a beast. Unwilling targets make a Wis save. It gains temporary hit points from the new form.

name: Stone Shape
summary: Mould a piece of stone into any shape: a weapon, a coffer, a doorway.

name: Stoneskin
summary: The target has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage.

name: Summon Aberration
summary: Call an Aberrant Spirit (beholderkin, mind flayer or slaad) that fights for you.

name: Summon Construct
summary: Call a Construct Spirit of clay, metal or stone that fights for you.

name: Summon Elemental
summary: Call an Elemental Spirit of air, earth, fire or water that fights for you.

name: Vitriolic Sphere
summary: An orb of acid bursts in a 20-foot sphere: 10d4 acid now and more at the end of the next turn on a failed Dex save.

name: Wall of Fire
summary: A wall of flame up to 60 feet long. One side burns creatures near it and those passing through for 5d8 fire.

name: Animate Objects
summary: Bring nonmagical objects to life to fight for you, commanded with a bonus action.

name: Bigby's Hand
summary: A Large hand of force that can punch, shove, grapple or shield, commanded with a bonus action.

name: Cloudkill
summary: A 20-foot sphere of poisonous fog that drifts away from you each turn. Con save or poison damage.

name: Cone of Cold
summary: Con save or 8d8 cold damage, half on success. Creatures killed become frozen statues.

name: Conjure Elemental
summary: A Large elemental spirit fills a space near you, restraining or damaging creatures that come close.

name: Contact Other Plane
summary: Ask an otherworldly entity up to five questions. Int save or take psychic damage and be incapacitated.

name: Creation
summary: Pull shadow-stuff into a nonliving object of vegetable or mineral matter. Harder materials last a shorter time.

name: Dominate Person
summary: Wis save or the humanoid is charmed and follows your telepathic commands.

name: Dream
summary: Enter the dreams of a creature you know to converse with it, or as a monster to deny it rest.

name: Geas
summary: Wis save or the target is compelled to follow a command, taking psychic damage when it acts against it.

name: Hold Monster
summary: Wis save or any creature is paralyzed. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

name: Jallarzi's Storm of Radiance
summary: A 10-foot cylinder of radiant light and thunder. Creatures inside are blinded, deafened and take radiant and thunder damage.

name: Legend Lore
summary: Learn significant lore about a famous person, place or object you name or hold.

name: Mislead
summary: You turn invisible while an illusory double appears and moves at your command; you can see and hear through it.

name: Modify Memory
summary: Wis save or you reshape the target's memory of an event from the last 24 hours.

name: Passwall
summary: A passage opens through wood, plaster or stone, up to 20 feet deep.

name: Planar Binding
summary: Cha save or a celestial, elemental, fey or fiend must serve you for the duration. Higher slots extend it.

name: Rary's Telepathic Bond
summary: Link up to eight willing creatures telepathically, at any distance on the same plane.

name: Scrying
summary: Spy on a creature through an invisible sensor. Wis save, modified by how well you know it.

name: Seeming
summary: Change the appearance of any number of creatures you can see, including their clothes and gear.

name: Steel Wind Strike
summary: Flourish a weapon and vanish: make melee spell attacks against up to five creatures for 6d10 force, then teleport near one.

name: Summon Dragon
summary: Call a Draconic Spirit that fights for you, can be ridden and breathes elemental damage.

name: Telekinesis
summary: Move creatures or objects up to 1,000 pounds with your mind, or restrain a creature.

name: Teleportation Circle
summary: Draw a circle linked to a permanent circle whose sigils you know; anyone entering is transported.

name: Wall of Force
summary: An invisible, indestructible wall, dome or sphere of force. Disintegrate destroys it.

name: Wall of Stone
summary: A nonmagical stone wall of ten panels. If you keep concentration, it becomes permanent.

name: Yolande's Regal Presence
summary: An aura of majesty: creatures near you make Wis saves or take psychic damage and fall prone or are pushed away.

name: Arcane Gate
summary: Two linked portals; anything that enters one exits the other.

name: Chain Lightning
summary: A bolt strikes a target and then up to three more nearby, each for 10d8 lightning (Dex save for half).

name: Circle of Death
summary: A 60-foot sphere of negative energy deals heavy necrotic damage (Con save for half).

name: Contingency
summary: Store a spell of 5th level or lower to cast itself on you when a condition you name occurs.

name: Create Undead
summary: Raise ghouls (or ghasts, wights and mummies at higher slots) that obey you for 24 hours. Cast at night.

name: Disintegrate
summary: Dex save or 10d6 + 40 force damage. A creature reduced to 0 hit points turns to dust.

name: Drawmij's Instant Summons
summary: Mark an object; crush a sapphire to summon it to your hand from anywhere.

name: Eyebite
summary: Each turn, target a creature with a Wis save or it falls asleep, panics, or is sickened.

name: Flesh to Stone
summary: Con saves over several turns; three failures turn the target to stone for good.

name: Globe of Invulnerability
summary: A shimmering 10-foot barrier blocks spells of 5th level or lower cast from outside.

name: Guards and Wards
summary: Ward a stronghold with fog, locked doors, webs, confusing corridors and other defences.

name: Magic Jar
summary: Move your soul into a container, then possess nearby humanoids (Cha save to resist).

name: Mass Suggestion
summary: Like Suggestion, but up to twelve creatures, and it lasts a full day without concentration.

name: Move Earth
summary: Reshape dirt, sand or clay in an area up to 40 feet on a side, changing its elevation over time.

name: Otiluke's Freezing Sphere
summary: A frigid globe bursts for 10d6 cold in a 60-foot sphere and freezes water. Can be held and thrown later.

name: Otto's Irresistible Dance
summary: The target dances helplessly: disadvantage on Dex saves and attacks, and others have advantage against it.

name: Programmed Illusion
summary: An illusion of an object, creature or event that plays when a condition you set occurs.

name: Summon Fiend
summary: Call a Fiendish Spirit (demon, devil or yugoloth) that fights for you.

name: Sunbeam
summary: A beam of sunlight: Con save or 6d8 radiant and blinded. Repeat with an action each turn.

name: Tasha's Bubbling Cauldron
summary: Conjure a cauldron that fills with potions of a spell you know. The potions vanish when you recast.

name: True Seeing
summary: The target gains Truesight out to 120 feet.

name: Wall of Ice
summary: A wall of ice that deals cold damage when it forms and leaves a frigid sheet of air when broken.

name: Delayed Blast Fireball
summary: A glowing bead that grows more powerful each round until it detonates as a huge fireball.

name: Etherealness
summary: Step into the Ethereal Plane, where you can move through solid objects.

name: Finger of Death
summary: Con save or 7d8 + 30 necrotic. A humanoid killed rises as a zombie under your command.

name: Forcecage
summary: An invisible cage or box of force traps everything inside. Teleporting out requires a save.

name: Mirage Arcane
summary: Reshape the look, sound, feel and smell of terrain up to a square mile. The illusion feels real.

name: Mordenkainen's Magnificent Mansion
summary: Open an extradimensional mansion with rooms, food and a hundred servants.

name: Mordenkainen's Sword
summary: A spectral sword attacks for you, dealing force damage. Move and attack with it as a bonus action.

name: Plane Shift
summary: Transport up to nine willing creatures to another plane, or banish an unwilling one with a melee attack.

name: Prismatic Spray
summary: Eight-coloured rays. Each creature is struck by a random colour: elemental damage, restraint or banishment.

name: Project Image
summary: Create an illusory copy of yourself that you can see, hear and speak through at great distance.

name: Reverse Gravity
summary: Gravity flips in a 50-foot cylinder. Everything not anchored falls upward.

name: Sequester
summary: Hide a creature or object from divination; a creature enters suspended animation until a condition is met.

name: Simulacrum
summary: Make an obedient duplicate of a creature from snow and ice, with half its hit points.

name: Symbol
summary: Inscribe a glyph that unleashes death, discord, fear, pain, sleep or stunning when triggered.

name: Teleport
summary: Transport yourself and up to eight others to a destination on the same plane. Familiarity decides accuracy.

name: Antimagic Field
summary: A 10-foot emanation where spells and magic items stop working.

name: Antipathy/Sympathy
summary: Enchant a creature or object to repel or attract a kind of creature you choose.

name: Befuddlement
summary: Int save or 10d12 psychic and the target can't cast spells or think clearly, repeating saves every 30 days.

name: Clone
summary: Grow an inert duplicate of a creature in a vessel. If the original dies, its soul moves into the clone.

name: Control Weather
summary: Change the weather within 5 miles over time: precipitation, temperature and wind.

name: Demiplane
summary: Open a shadowy door to a 30-foot empty room in its own demiplane. Objects left there remain.

name: Dominate Monster
summary: Wis save or any creature is charmed and follows your telepathic commands.

name: Incendiary Cloud
summary: A 20-foot sphere of embers that drifts each turn. Dex save or heavy fire damage.

name: Maze
summary: Banish a creature into a labyrinthine demiplane. It must use Int checks to escape.

name: Mind Blank
summary: Immunity to psychic damage, charm, and any magic that reads thoughts or locates the target.

name: Power Word Stun
summary: A creature with 150 hit points or fewer is stunned; others have their speed reduced to 0.

name: Sunburst
summary: Brilliant sunlight in a 60-foot sphere: Con save or 12d6 radiant and blinded. Dispels magical darkness.

name: Telepathy
summary: A telepathic link with one willing creature anywhere on the same plane.

name: Astral Projection
summary: Project yourself and up to eight others into the Astral Plane, linked to your bodies by silver cords.

name: Foresight
summary: The target can't be surprised and has advantage on d20 tests; others have disadvantage against it.

name: Gate
summary: Open a portal to another plane. Speak a creature's true name to pull it through.

name: Imprisonment
summary: Wis save or the target is bound by burial, chains, a hedge maze, minimus containment or slumber.

name: Meteor Swarm
summary: Four blazing orbs each deal 20d6 fire and 20d6 bludgeoning in a 40-foot sphere (Dex save for half).

name: Power Word Kill
summary: A creature with 100 hit points or fewer dies; otherwise it takes 12d12 psychic damage.

name: Prismatic Wall
summary: A seven-layered wall of light. Each layer inflicts a different harm and must be undone a different way.

name: Shapechange
summary: Turn into a creature of your level or lower and change forms again on later turns.

name: Time Stop
summary: Time stops for everyone else while you take 1d4 + 1 turns. Affecting others ends it.

name: True Polymorph
summary: Transform a creature into another creature or an object, or an object into a creature. Holds permanently with full concentration.

name: Weird
summary: Phantasmal terrors in a 30-foot sphere: Wis save or 10d10 psychic and frightened.

name: Wish
summary: Duplicate any spell of 8th level or lower, or ask for something greater, at the risk of losing it forever.
